threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly with only the following three user-requested follow-up changes. Preserve its draft state and existing base; do not create a separate PR as a workaround.

1. Remove the redundant `equalTo(ERROR_TYPE, null)` assertion from `AbstractAws2ClientTest.testS3ServiceError` in `instrumentation/aws-sdk/aws-sdk-2.2/testing/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awssdk/v2_2/AbstractAws2ClientTest.java`. The surrounding `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)` already excludes unlisted attributes. Remove any import only if it becomes unused.

2. Delete `instrumentation/aws-sdk/aws-sdk-2.2/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awssdk/v2_2/internal/AwsSdkHttpClientSuppressionAttributesExtractorTest.java`. It only checks the hard-coded getter result and does not exercise actual suppression. Do not replace it with another getter-only test or expand this into suppression changes.

3. Change generic AWS schema selection from `SchemaUrls.V1_37_0` to `SchemaUrls.V1_44_0` in both AWS SDK versions' `internal/AwsSdkInstrumenterFactory.java`, under `instrumentation/aws-sdk/aws-sdk-1.11/library` and `instrumentation/aws-sdk/aws-sdk-2.2/library`. Update the directly corresponding generic AWS schema assertions, including `AbstractS3ClientTest.testServiceError` and `AbstractAws2ClientTest.testS3ServiceError`. The AWS convention in v1.44.0 still specifies the existing `rpc.system="aws-api"`, separate `rpc.service`, and operation-only `rpc.method`; see https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.44.0/model/aws/sdk-spans.yaml. The fixed schema should represent AWS conventions independently of RPC configuration. Preserve specialized database, messaging, and GenAI schema overrides.

Keep the rest of the PR's AWS/RPC decoupling intact, including independent HTTP suppression. In particular, preserve the SDK v1 `equalTo(ERROR_TYPE, AmazonS3Exception.class.getName())` expectation and current production error handling. Its exception-class value comes from existing HTTP extraction; changing error classification across SDK versions is outside these three requested items. Do not modify the `builder -> {}` customizer arguments or the common RPC API.

Follow repository instructions and run the narrowest relevant formatting and validation for these changes. Do not wait for CI or merge the PR.
